```{r}
# First we acquire and parse the EIA State Electricity Profiles into a tidy data frame:
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(httr2)
library(rvest)

get_eia_sep <- function(state, abbr){
    library(tidyverse)
    library(stringr)
    library(httr2)
    library(rvest)
    library(fs)
  
    state_formatted <- str_to_lower(state) |> str_replace_all("\\s", "")
    
    dir_name <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
    file_name <- fs::path(dir_name, state_formatted)
    
    fs::dir_create(dir_name, recurse=TRUE)
    
    if(!fs::file_exists(file_name)){
        BASE_URL <- "https://www.eia.gov"
        RESPONSE <- request(BASE_URL) |> 
          req_url_path("electricity", 
                       "state", 
                       state_formatted) |>
          req_headers(
            `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0"
            ) |>   
          req_retry(
                max_tries = 4, 
          ) |>
          req_perform(file_name)
    
        resp_check_status(RESPONSE)
    }
    
    TABLE <- read_html(file_name) |> 
        html_element("table") |> 
        html_table() |>
        mutate(Item = str_to_lower(Item))
    
    if("U.S. rank" %in% colnames(TABLE)){
        TABLE <- TABLE |> rename(Rank = `U.S. rank`)
    }
    
    CO2_MWh <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "carbon dioxide (lbs/mwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |> 
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    PRIMARY <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "primary energy source") |> 
        pull(Rank)
    
    RATE <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "average retail price (cents/kwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        as.numeric()
    
    GENERATION_MWh <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "net generation (megawatthours)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    data.frame(CO2_MWh               = CO2_MWh, 
               primary_source        = PRIMARY,
               electricity_price_MWh = RATE * 10, # / 100 cents to dollars &
               # * 1000 kWh to MWH 
               generation_MWh        = GENERATION_MWh, 
               state                 = state, 
               abbreviation          = abbr
    )
}

EIA_SEP_REPORT <- map2(state.name, state.abb, get_eia_sep) |> list_rbind()
```

```{r}
#| echo: true

load_ntd_energy <- function(){
  library(readxl)
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_ENERGY_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_energy.xlsx")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://www.transit.dot.gov/") |>
      req_url_path("sites",
                   "fta.dot.gov",
                   "files",
                   "2026-09",
                   "2025 Energy Consumption_260806.xlsx") |> 
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Energy File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_energy.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  to_numeric_fill_0 <- function(x){
    x <- if_else(x == "-", NA, x)
    replace_na(as.numeric(x), 0)
  }

  read_excel(NTD_ENERGY_FILE) |> 
    select(-c(`Reporter Type`, 
              `Reporting Module`, 
              `Gallons of Other Fuel`, 
              `Other Fuel Description`)) |>
    mutate(across(-c(`Agency Name`, 
                     `Mode`,
                     `TOS`), 
                  to_numeric_fill_0)) |>
    group_by(`NTD ID`, `Mode`, `Agency Name`) |>
    summarize(across(where(is.numeric), sum), 
              .groups = "keep") |>
    mutate(ENERGY = sum(c_across(c(where(is.numeric))))) |>
    filter(ENERGY > 0) |>
    select(-ENERGY) |>
    ungroup()
}

NTD_ENERGY <- load_ntd_energy()
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| output: false
load_ntd_service <- function(){
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_SERVICE_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_service.csv")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://data.transportation.gov/resource/4fir-qbim.csv") |>
      req_url_query(`$query`=paste(
        "SELECT  `_5_digit_ntd_id` AS `NTD_ID`", 
        "`max_agency` AS `AGENCY`",
        "`max_reporter_type` AS `reporter_type`",
        "`max_organization_type` AS `organization_type`",
        "`max_city` AS `city`",
        "`max_state` AS `state`",
        "`mode`",
        "`type_of_service`",
        "`max_primary_uza_code` as `uza_code`",
        "`max_primary_uza_name` as `uza_name`",
        "`max_primary_uza_area_sq_miles` as `uza_sq_miles`",
        "`max_primary_uza_population` as `uza_population`",
        "`max_service_area_sq_miles` as `service_area_sq_miles`",
        "`max_service_area_population` as `service_area_population`",
        "`questionable_record` as `flagged_likely_inaccurate`",
        "`sum_unlinked_passenger_trips_upt` as `total_upt`",
        "`sum_passenger_miles` WHERE caseless_one_of(`report_year`, '2025') limit 50000", 
        sep=",")) |>
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Service File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_service.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  read_csv(NTD_SERVICE_FILE) |>
    mutate(flagged_likely_inaccurate = !is.na(flagged_likely_inaccurate))
}

NTD_SERVICE <- load_ntd_service()
```

To integrate state-level environmental data with transit energy consumption, the relational architecture below relies on NTD_SERVICE as a necessary bridge between datasets. Because NTD_ENERGY tracks fuel metrics without regional indicators, it is first linked to NTD_SERVICE using a compound key of agency ID and mode of transportation to accurately align operational metrics across specific transit modes. Once merged, the State variable enables a second link to the EIA_SEP_REPORT table. As illustrated in the diagram, this step-by-step pipeline combines agency-level fuel data with state-level emissions and power grid characteristics.

```{r}
#| echo: true
# Next, we recode the technical transit mode abbreviations into readable descriptions:
recode_values <- function(x, ...) {
    args <- list(...)
    val <- args[[x]]
    if (is.null(val)) {
        return(args[["default"]])
    }
    return(val)
}
NTD_ENERGY <- NTD_ENERGY |>
    mutate(Mode = case_when(
        Mode == "HR" ~ "Heavy Rail",
        Mode == "MB" ~ "Bus",
        Mode == "LR" ~ "Light Rail",
        Mode == "CR" ~ "Commuter Rail",
        Mode == "DR" ~ "Demand Response",
        TRUE ~ "Other/Unknown"
    ))
```

```{r}
    )
```

Based on the table, West Virginia stands out with the highest carbon intensity in its power grid at 1,912 lbs of CO₂ per MWh generated, closely followed by Kentucky (1,744 lbs) and Wyoming (1,724 lbs). Coal serves as the primary energy source driving these elevated emissions in four out of the top five states, with Hawaii standing as the sole exception by relying on petroleum. However, Hawaii also exhibits a distinct profile compared to the continental states: its total power generation remains relatively low at 9.2M MWh (whereas the other four states produce between 40.7M and 67.0M MWh) and its electricity price reaches a staggering \$380 per MWh, which is more than triple the \$91 to \$111 per MWh range seen across the rest of the top emitters.

```{r}
  ) |>
  summarize(total_upt = sum(total_upt, na.rm = TRUE))

  mutate(`NTD ID` = as.character(`NTD ID`)) |>

  arrange(desc(total_biodiesel)) |>
```

```{r}
# Next, we merge the three core datasets and compute total greenhouse gas emissions per Agency and Mode:
complete_transit_data <- NTD_SERVICE |>
    inner_join(
      NTD_ENERGY |> mutate(`NTD ID` = as.character(`NTD ID`)),
      join_by(NTD_ID == `NTD ID`, mode == Mode, AGENCY == `Agency Name`)
    ) |>
    inner_join(
      EIA_SEP_REPORT,
      join_by(state == abbreviation)
    ) |>
    mutate(
        emissions_electricity = (`Kilowatt hours of Electric Battery` + `Kilowatt hours of Electric Propulsion`) * (CO2_MWh / 1e6),
        emissions_diesel = `Gallons of Diesel Fuel` * 22.4,
        emissions_cng = `Gallons of Compressed Natural Gas` * 120.6 / 1.2,
        total_emissions_lbs = emissions_electricity + emissions_diesel + emissions_cng
    )
```

```{r}
# Next, we normalize emissions by passenger usage metrics to evaluate operational efficiency:
agency_efficiency <- complete_transit_data |>
    group_by(AGENCY, state) |>
    summarize(
        total_emissions = sum(total_emissions_lbs, na.rm = TRUE),
        total_upt = sum(total_upt, na.rm = TRUE),
        total_passenger_miles = sum(sum_passenger_miles, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(total_upt > 100000) |>
    mutate(
        emissions_per_upt = total_emissions / total_upt,
        emissions_per_mile = total_emissions / total_passenger_miles
    )
```

```{r}
# 1. Build the complete merged transit dataset (Agency + Mode grain)
complete_transit_data <- NTD_SERVICE |>
    inner_join(
      NTD_ENERGY |> mutate(`NTD ID` = as.character(`NTD ID`)),
      join_by(NTD_ID == `NTD ID`, mode == Mode, AGENCY == `Agency Name`)
    ) |>
    inner_join(
      EIA_SEP_REPORT,
      join_by(state == abbreviation)
    ) |>
    mutate(
        # Calculate emissions by fuel source
        emissions_electricity = (`Kilowatt hours of Electric Battery` + `Kilowatt hours of Electric Propulsion`) * (CO2_MWh / 1e6),
        emissions_diesel = `Gallons of Diesel Fuel` * 22.4,
        emissions_cng = `Gallons of Compressed Natural Gas` * 120.6 / 1.2,
        
        # Total emissions in pounds
        total_emissions_lbs = emissions_electricity + emissions_diesel + emissions_cng
    )

# 2. Task Output 1: Summary table of total emissions by Agency and Mode (Top 10 highest emitters)
agency_mode_emissions <- complete_transit_data |>
    group_by(AGENCY, mode, state) |>
    summarize(
        total_upt = sum(total_upt, na.rm = TRUE),
        total_emissions_lbs = sum(total_emissions_lbs, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total_emissions_lbs))

# Display the top emitting agency-mode pairs
print("Top Emitters by Agency and Mode:")
print(head(agency_mode_emissions, 10))

# 3. Task Output 2: State-level aggregation for environmental impact reporting
state_emissions_summary <- complete_transit_data |>
    group_by(state, primary_source) |>
    summarize(
        agency_count = n_distinct(AGENCY),
        total_state_emissions_lbs = sum(total_emissions_lbs, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_co2_mwh = mean(CO2_MWh, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total_state_emissions_lbs))

print("Emissions Summary by State and Primary Energy Source:")
print(head(state_emissions_summary, 10))
```
